  WHY: The fragment is folded into CHANGELOG.md and shipped to consumers, so it will tell maintainers nothing changes while the first post-release `@stable` sync edits and commits their `.github/dependabot.yml`/`.yaml`; it also contradicts lines 4 and 8 of the same fragment. - scripts/sync_dependabot_exclusions.py:367-505 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `owned = template_basenames(templates_dir) | set(managed)` (line 504) makes every top-level workflow-template basename part of the drop-set in `_edit_item`/`plan_edit` (`if unquote(value) in owned_paths: drop.add(index)`, lines 367-372), but only the current profile's managed set is re-added, so a consumer exclusion for an unmanaged template wrapper (e.g. `.github/workflows/ai-old.yml` under `core`) is silently removed.
  WHY: Now that a1d8295 attests the helper, this path runs against real consumer configs and lets Dependabot resume bump PRs for paths the consumer excluded; `test_sync_owned_entries_follow_a_profile_change` (tests/test_sync_dependabot_exclusions.py:172-191) locks the behaviour in. Severity disagreement: gemini, minimax and luna rated it MAJOR, sonnet and glm rated it NIT (sonnet says it is acceptable as designed if the owner confirms), so the highest (MAJOR→high) is used.
- scripts/release_manifest.py:9-31 | severity=low | confidence=5

- changelog.d/9485-dependabot-managed-wrapper-exclusions.md:line 6, the "Activation:" paragraph | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The paragraph says `scripts/release_manifest.py` does not list the helper yet and that adding it to `SURFACE_RULES` is the follow-up. Head commit a1d8295 added `("file", "scripts/sync_dependabot_exclusions.py", False)` to `SURFACE_RULES` in scripts/release_manifest.py at line 101, so the next manifest attests the helper and `dependabot_sync` (around line 896) and `verify_reproduce` (line 2624) run it. The paragraph also contradicts lines 4 and 8 of the same fragment.
  WHY: Consumers will read that nothing changes, but the first `@stable` sync edits and commits `.github/dependabot.yml` / `.github/dependabot.yaml`. Fix: rewrite line 6 to say the helper is an optional file rule, attested from this release on.
- scripts/sync_dependabot_exclusions.py:`run()`, the `owned = template_basenames(templates_dir) | set(managed)` line, feeding `_edit_item`'s `if unquote(value) in owned_paths: drop.add(index)` | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: On a narrow profile such as `core`, a consumer's own exclusion for a template-named wrapper that profile does not manage (e.g. `.github/workflows/ai-plan.yml`) is removed on every sync and not added back; `test_sync_owned_entries_follow_a_profile_change` locks this in.
  WHY: Activation turns this from inert into live, and Dependabot resumes bump PRs for that file. It is a regression in the consumer's own config, not a pipeline break, and is acceptable as designed if the owner confirms the trade-off.
